sections.title: Method
lines: per-run window FFT amplitudes at paddle frequency f, computed over
FFT band          : ±0.05 Hz around target f
c_g dispersion    : full ω²=gk·tanh(kh) via wavescripts.constants.c_group

sections.title: Aggregation
lines: A_IN      = mean across runs of per-run window-FFT amplitude
A_IN_sd   = run-to-run std of per-run A_IN (around the mean, ddof=1)
A_OUT_sd  = run-to-run std of per-run A_OUT
